name: Meerut
description: Origin of the 1857 War of Independence where sepoys broke ranks on May 10, 1857.

name: Delhi
description: Historical seat of power; epicenter of the 1857 siege, 1929 Assembly bomb action, and 1947 Independence declaration at Red Fort.

name: Jhansi
description: The heroic fortress city defended by Rani Lakshmibai during the 1857 Rebellion.

name: Champaran
description: Site of Mahatma Gandhi's first Satyagraha in India (1917) against oppressive British indigo planters.

name: Amritsar
description: Location of the tragic Jallianwala Bagh massacre of 1919.

name: Kakori
description: Site of the legendary 1925 HRA train action led by Ram Prasad Bismil and Ashfaqulla Khan.

name: Dandi
description: Coastal village destination of Mahatma Gandhi's 240-mile Salt March in 1930.

name: Mumbai (Bombay)
description: Birthplace of the Indian National Congress (1885), Quit India Movement flag hoisting (1942), and Royal Indian Navy Mutiny (1946).

name: Kolkata (Calcutta)
description: Crucible of Bengal Renaissance, Swadeshi anti-partition movement (1905), and Netaji's escape in 1941.

name: Rampa Agency (Godavari)
description: Hilly jungle agency tracts where Alluri Sitarama Raju waged the 1922-1924 Rampa Adivasi Rebellion.
